items.series: T-PLUS P2 It really happened, on the clock
items.hypothesis: TP-B1 P2: DOCUMENTARY true now, on the live clock; primary = public views at 48 h.
items.caption:
Send Voyager 1 a message today. It arrives tomorrow.
Today the one-way trip at light speed takes 23 h 58 min (JPL Horizons). On 18 Nov it becomes the first spacecraft one light-day from Earth (NASA).
